requirements.text: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
requirements.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones

outcomes.description: Move the mug so that it is positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.target: The mug is visibly positioned to the right of the headphones.
outcomes.reference: The headphones in the image; compare the mug’s position with the headphones.

nodes.question: Does the edited image show the source mug itself moved to the right of the headphones, rather than merely adding another mug there?
nodes.criteria: Compare the source and edited images to identify the source mug and assess its position relative to the headphones. Pass only when visual evidence reliably supports that the source mug itself is now to the right of the headphones. Fail when evidence reliably establishes that the source mug was not moved there, such as a clearly identifiable source mug remaining at its former position while a different mug appears on the right. Use unknown when the former-position blur, scale, lighting, appearance changes, or other ambiguity prevents reliable determination of the source mug's identity or movement. A mug appearing on the right alone does not establish that the source mug was moved.
nodes.binding: Cross-image binding: the source image's blue mug, identifiable by its distinctive body and handle, and the same headphones visible in both source and edited images. Compare their corresponding regions and relative positions across images; allow for changes in scale, lighting, and appearance.

nodes.question: In the edited image, is a mug visibly positioned to the right of the headphones?
nodes.criteria: Inspect the edited image and compare the visible mug or mugs with the headphones. Pass only if a mug is clearly positioned to the right of the headphones. Fail if the image reliably shows no mug to their right. Use unknown if the objects or their relative positions cannot be determined reliably. This condition checks the requested final spatial relation only; a pass does not establish that the source mug itself was moved.
nodes.binding: The mug or mugs and the headphones in the edited image; assess their visible left-to-right positions.

program.checker_template: Evaluate ONE independent required condition against the SOURCE and EDITED images. No reference label, previous answers or optimization feedback is supplied. Return pass if the condition is satisfied, fail if it is not satisfied, or unknown if the evidence cannot establish an answer. Inspect only this saved condition, its criteria and binding. Report factual evidence and confidence (0..1 or null). A pass means satisfaction of THIS condition, not an overall edit label. Do not anticipate the optimizer's target. Missing evidence or transport/schema failures must not become a negative observation. The final overall label is computed by code; you never supply it.

observations.evidence: The source blue mug is clearly left of the headphones. In the edited image, a mug appears to the right of the headphones, but the source mug's former area is a blurred blue patch and the right-side mug looks different in color and appearance. The image does not reliably establish whether the source mug itself was moved or whether another mug was added.
In the edited image, a clearly visible mug is positioned to the right of the headphones. There is also another mug to their left; the right-side mug satisfies the stated condition.

findings.source_phrase: Move the mug to the right of the headphones
findings.question: Does the edited image provide reliable visual evidence that the source blue mug itself is the mug now to the right of the headphones, rather than that the source mug remains at its former location and a different mug is on the right?
findings.criteria: Compare the source mug’s distinctive shape and handle with the edited mugs, allowing for changes in scale and appearance. Treat the blurred blue area left of the headphones and the differing appearance of the right-side mug as evidence to assess, not as conclusive proof of identity or non-identity. Pass only if the source mug’s movement to the right is reliably supported; fail only if the evidence reliably establishes it was not moved there; otherwise unknown.
findings.evidence: The source shows one blue mug left of the headphones. The edited image shows a blurred blue patch left of the headphones, a small light-colored mug near the headphones, and another mug to their right. The right-side mug does not visibly match the source mug’s blue appearance, while the former area is blurred.
findings.rationale: The existing cross-image check d1 already raises identity and movement uncertainty, and d2 only verifies the final spatial relation for any mug. A focused investigation of whether the source mug is identifiable among the edited objects is needed to judge the requested move without treating the right-side mug alone as fulfillment.
